description: C3 regulatory corpus for PP1: the Inland Revenue Act No. 24 of 2017 and the amendment Acts that changed personal relief or individual income tax rates. Checked 2026-10-11: Acts No. 4 of 2023, No. 14 of 2023 and No. 11 of 2026 do not change either, so they are excluded from the PP1 slice. All four are taken from the Inland Revenue Department's Acts page (https://www.ird.gov.lk/en/publications/sitepages/acts.aspx); documents.gov.lk /view/ links stopped working on 2026-10-12.

documents.title: Inland Revenue Act, No. 24 of 2017
documents.relevance: Principal Act: First Schedule para 1 (individual rates), Fifth Schedule para 2(a) (personal relief)

documents.title: Inland Revenue (Amendment) Act, No. 10 of 2021
documents.relevance: s.51 individual rates from 2020-01-01; s.55 personal relief Rs. 3,000,000 from 2020-01-01 (enacted retrospectively)

documents.title: Inland Revenue (Amendment) Act, No. 45 of 2022
documents.relevance: s.33 individual rates (YoA 2022/23 split, from YoA 2023/24); s.36 personal relief Rs. 1,200,000

documents.title: Inland Revenue (Amendment) Act, No. 2 of 2025
documents.relevance: s.3 individual rates from YoA 2025/26; s.5 personal relief Rs. 1,800,000
